{{Quote|If you think negotiating is the right thing to do, let's talk to her.''"<br />"''The Senate's made it illegal.''"<br />"''Illegal?''"<br />"''They say ''official'' meetings would only ''legitimize'' the Separatists.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and Padmé Amidala|<ref name="HoBS" />}}
Following the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|secession]] of a multitude of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] into the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] passed a '''law''' prohibiting the [[Senator/Legends|senators]] of the Republic and [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist]] Senates from communicating with each other. This law continued into the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and hampered a [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|peace deal]] between Republic Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and Separatist Senator [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]].
